stated_in.quote: Every regular parameter with a default and every keyword-only parameter that can legally be passed by keyword must reach the generated wrapper as `name=name`, so a value supplied by keyword remains in the wrapper's `**kwargs` instead of being flattened into `*args`.

Generated invocations must keep positional-only parameters positional, and when a signature has `*args`, all regular parameters before it must remain positional so nonempty varargs cannot collide with keyword forwarding.
